findings.text: _described_test_path duplicates the tests/-path extraction the repository already owns as _TEST_PATH_PATTERN at reckon/crew/recovery_repair_dispatch.py:687 rather than extending it, so the two accept different file sets (any suffixed path versus *.py) and a later change to one will not reach the other.

_batch() gives no entry a write_paths field, so the queue-time exemption at reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py:597 (derive_write_paths=not write_paths) is reached by no test; deleting that argument would leave the suite green while refusing a batch whose entries supply their own paths.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit from 81274f7aad back to base 9049dfcc75: c7088c12a0 adds the described-test rule, f4fb19dbae exempts a release when the request supplied its own write paths, 2b19de28a9 and 81274f7aad add and amend the evidence fragment — 344 insertions and 9 deletions over three files.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done-when's five entries, its two refusals quoting "the new test" and the sentence, its "its regression test" variant, its literal-path case and its base-revision negative control are each asserted at tests/test_a_batch_entry_carries_its_done_when_test.py:172-205, with logs/repair-base-suite.log (51 passed, EXIT=0) and logs/repair-head-final.log (53 passed, EXIT=0) recorded; the all_debug placement the done-when also names appears in no log header.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is that a batch entry carry the test path its done-when names when its write-paths sentence names that file only by description; reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py:396 defines _described_test_path, which takes the single tests/ path from the done-when, and the five-entry fixture stores entry s1 as ["one.py", "tests/test_one.py"].
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records status complete, four commits, baseline_suite 51 passed and after_suite 53 passed both with exit_status 0 and empty failure_ids, the reverted-hunk negative control, and identical seven-id importer failures at base and head.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the reviewed manifest's orientation names reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py, tests/test_a_batch_entry_carries_its_done_when_test.py, the evidence fragment and a figure directory; the diff touches exactly the first three and nothing else.

justifications.durability: tests/test_a_batch_entry_carries_its_done_when_test.py:232 fails when f4fb19dbae's hunk is reverted (logs/repair-negative-reverted.log: 1 failed, 1 passed, EXIT=1) and the main rule fails at the base revision, but the queue-time exemption at reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py:597 is reached by no test.
justifications.evidence: logs/repair-head-final.log records 53 passed EXIT=0 at 81274f7aad and logs/negative-control-base.log records the base revision failing at assert ['one.py'] == ['one.py', 'tests/test_one.py'], but the importer arm logs/head-importers.log ran at c7088c12a0 rather than the final head and no log header records the all_debug placement the done-when names.
justifications.fit: reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py:119 follows the module's compiled-pattern convention beside _SENTENCE_END at :113 and reuses _PATH_TOKEN and plan_review._done_when_paragraph; no added name carries a plan, ticket or version label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py:396-424 resolves a described test from the done-when and refuses zero or two by name, and the guard at reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py:539 keeps an entry-supplied write path out of the release derivation, so the plan's "entry that gives its own write paths is unchanged" clause holds.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py:396 rebuilds a tests/-path extractor that reckon/crew/recovery_repair_dispatch.py:687 already owns as _TEST_PATH_PATTERN, with a different acceptance rule and no shared owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff changes only reckon/crew/dispatch_batch.py, tests/test_a_batch_entry_carries_its_done_when_test.py and the granted docs/evidence/fragments/a-queue-holds-the-whole-plan/a-batch-entry-carries-its-done-when-test.html, with no unrelated cleanup.
